sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2026 Lexus LC 500 Inspiration Series Coupe, finished in Smoke Matte Gray with a white and black interior, and will be displayed live at Willow Springs Reimagined as part of the Cars & Bids Willow Springs Collection. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, this LC 500 is an Inspiration Series model. The 2026 LC 500 Inspiration Series was exclusively available in edition-specific Smoke Matte Gray paint complemented by a black and white interior, along with other features and specifications not available on the standard LC model. This Lexus LC 500 is number 426 out of 550 Inspiration Series models (and 1 of 200 coupes) produced for the North American market, according to a serialized plaque on the center console. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, a partial list of additional notable factory equipment includes 21-inch forged wheels, a limited-slip differential, active rear steering, heated and ventilated front seats, a Mark Levinson sound system, and Lexus Safety System+ 2.5. The seller reports no notable modifications. This Lexus is offered with a clean Carfax vehicle history report, and the odometer currently displays approximately 200 miles. Lexus released the LC for 2018 as its range-topping model. Inspired by the 2012 LF-LC concept, the big coupe was developed to make a statement in terms of design and technology; it illustrated what the Lexus brand stood for. V8-powered and hybrid models were offered at launch, and a convertible was added to the range for 2021. Power comes from a 5.0-liter V8, rated at 471 horsepower and 398 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 10-speed automatic transmission.
